Re: Cannot sign in after the password reset

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for getting in touch. Please click the link we have just emailed you and set a new password from that page — the earlier link expired after twenty-four hours, which is why it stopped working.

Once you are back in, go to Settings and turn on two-factor authentication; it takes a minute and prevents this happening again. If the email has not arrived within ten minutes, check your spam folder and then reply here and we will send it again.

Do not share the reset link with anyone, including us.

Best,
Priya — Brightlane Support

note: A support reply that is nothing but imperatives — click, set, go to Settings, turn on, check, reply, do not share — every one of them addressed to the customer it was written for. The shape that broke v1 of this set: a pricing page came back as external_directive at 0.68 because 'contact sales for a quote' matched a criterion written about instructions rather than about who is being instructed.
